Usage: skilllint docs [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Fetch, query, and verify cached vendor documentation.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  fetch              Fetch a documentation page or return a cached copy.
  fetch-authorities  Fetch cached documentation for all normalized rule authority URLs.
  latest             Find the most recent cached file for a page name.
  sections           Print a table of sections in a cached markdown file.
  section            Print the text of a named section from a cached markdown file.
  verify             Verify a cached file against its .meta.json sidecar.
